book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: Yeso ka zoole ana o tare o kai

Aya za a nyimi na aromo a cake gwarnang ara yende na ara sau ne. Na ogongnga one oteze nane itǝzǝ ba tokpwe tone. Na Yeso bore bekaa na o tare o kai na, “Ezana a sauwo ko yisti o maParisa, omea ne rendeze aromoa ka wai belle.
Eyapa tarene ko pate ka ato pari ne, eyapa tarene ko baasa ka Ashili ta rosa ene kanza.
Za nyimi, pate epa eka aromo ne beka suk, a yo kona e oyangga, kanza epa eka ebeya a teto ta aromo a nyimi o todo, a yo beya o yangga nangka komana yo kona.
Ondooka ayo kona boome be wai
“Ying aja ang, eyang baala o ying, tane kone boome be andaaka ne wonze lepung, malo nyimi ne era ne ta ama o ye eyapa kanza ne.
Baya na ang bele ying ondooka eyo kona boome be wai: Kona na boome be Ashili, ondooka malo wonga lepung, waye ka o bare o tare oromo ola. Ang bekaa ying epeng e me, wa gwara e kona boome be wai.
E rosa obena e era e lishi e bangbako esu ba zaa emamate leere na? Pate ka nyimi Ashili ta a winǝ ka ondo a nyimi one ne.
Konana, Ashili rosa pate ogongnga sekpwe seeka seya tokpwe to ying. Nyimia waaza, tane kone boome ne. E kala e bangbako a cake e keeya.
“Eyang baala o ying, pate ondooka wa kabare ka mi a begeshe be aromo, mi ma eyang kabare ka wai a begeshe be otoma Ashili odera lepung.
Ondooka wa sanggang o rosa ong a begeshe be aromo, mima eyang sanggang o rosa wai a begeshe ba Atoma surǝ a zaa shili.
Pate ondooka wa beya angmǝ aburu aza Kena ka Oromo, Ashili yo kwizǝ madinǝ ma angmǝ me, a pate ondooka wa tambo aza obere Ashili, Ashili to kwizǝ madinǝ ma angmǝ me ne.
“A deya ka ying a madandaro ma o gwarzanang maYahuda ka core angmǝ aza o ying, ka ana togomo, ka ana obeka kone, tane zitǝ aza nangka eyo sǝǝrǝ tokpwe to ying ne kona aza epa o bekaa ne.
Aza nyimi o bere orere Ashili wayo baala ying epa eka eyo beka a were name.”
Angmǝ a gerpo aza ondo cǝka waye kale rara
Na ondo a nyimi aromo beka kai na, “Ondo baala, beka ondo a izi ong kawa are ro epa eka ate aro wa gbwi a wa baya ro ka e.”
Na Yeso kabare naka bekaana, “Oja ong, mana wa nyang togomo to cora angmǝ ying ka eyang ara magogoro ma ying?”
Naka bele aromo me na, “Konana. Eza na a sauwo ka o kombela o berendo, ocǝ magogoro ma oromo ba cake, waya ta ote ka wa cǝ ebeene o dera omaro ne.”
Aka bele ne angmǝ a gerpo yende, “Aye oromo yende ka waye ka ocǝ a sǝǝrǝ epaolya a cake.
Nawa bore madoola a lenyong le wai na, ‘Engta ka aro eke epaolya a cake ka ma cǝ ara ang ne, eya eyang ya naname?’
“Nawa beka okpwe wai na, ‘Nanname eng rosa epa oya. Eyang posa abenga ang, ang kang sowa a moole moole, kang kare epaolya na a maacǝ, ka magogoro mang pate a nyimi me.
Eng kang beka okpwe ong na, “Ahah, nanname oye ka epaolya a cake mame mayo rabo, oyo ya shenai a lyame, baya o teseke, o lye, o se, o kona oleba o.” ’
“Na Ashili beka a wai na, ‘Bo orara. A nyimi lelyaare leena oya gbwǝ. Magogoro mana a ba kurǝ okpwe o, mayo itǝ ma mana?’
“Na Yeso maare angmǝ ko bekaana, ‘Wayo itǝ nyimi ka pate ondooka wa kurǝ magogoro a cake ma okpwe wai, a begeshe Ashili wata ka eyapa ne.’ ”
Tane gare tokpwe to ying ka madoola ne
Na Yeso bekaa na o tare a kai na, “Aza nyimi, eyang bekaa ying tana e eze madoola aza epa eka eyo lya ka madibi maaka eyo amba apung aying ne.
Ebene oromo kala epaolya, a lepung le oromo kala magogoro mo amba.
Lakana egorogoro, neta waleze ebelo ne, ne ta senda ne, ne ta ka benga ne shebari kagoropate ne. A pate ka nyimi, Ashili nyaza ne epa o lya. Rosa na e kala engmeng edang.
Mana a nyimi o ying aza madoola ma wai, wa era a wa waleke tomore to wai ne?
Nangka eta ama oya epa e baate na ne, eyaka e ya doola o dangare me?

“Laka nangka eburu gongze, ne ta gole ne, ne ta sowa eyapa ne, ne ta dozaza madibi ne, pate ka nyimi eyang bele o ying, Ogomo Suleimanu ka ocǝ a wai, wata wa tukǝ amba madibi ma rere mo kala beburu be yende ne.
Ashili a ambaza mawake magogoro ma rere, mamea ayo gonta o ngmeengme, a leere a ese mai ola, shebari ying, eya wa era awata nya ying ne, eyaka e ta eke lenyong Ashili ne?
Tane oteze lenyong le ying aza ogera epa ka eyo lya ko sa ne, kane gare topkwe to ying aza e ne.
Aromo aka ne ta rosa Ashili ne a lerambo legoone, ne kanazang ba gera magogoro mana. Ying Ate o ying rose na eya yeme me.
Eke na lenyong leying a togomo to Ashili, Ashili yo nya ying pate magogoro maana.
Obaala aza o eza le'eke aza shili
“Tana e kone boome ne ying ana o tare ong ka eta gongnga ne, aza obena ate aying ya kona leba o nya o ying ocikǝ a nyimi togomo te wai.

Lisǝ na epa eka ezene ka e nya ana o dera emate me. E babare tokpwe to ying le'eke leeka le to caro ne, ocǝ omea wato maro ne ba shili. Ara a ka okǝri wa era awata ama okpwǝ me ne, ka ra aka egau ne era neta sheke ne.
Ara a ka ocǝ o zene, arame lenyong lo zene kanza.
O cikǝ aza o enda
“Cikǝ na e gonte ra zak, tane lambi eru masanto maying ne.
Na azara amea neya enda Ateokora one a wa surǝ a ozǝnggǝ o amare. Wa kurǝ kawa gware abuudu, aa ne pari wai a saseya.

Eyang baalo ying e peng me, wayo itǝ epa o zanta azara amea Ateokora wa deya wayo mana ne ane ta ne umǝ ne. Eyang belo ying, wayo lopa o dibi wai o gong, a wa bekaa ne kane cikǝ aro lye epaolya, wayo tare ne a yeyende a wa nyaza ne epaolya.
Wayo itǝ epa e lebo ka azara name ka Ateokora wa deya ba tera lelyaare na o sana ara a wa mana ne ba zo enda wai.
Eyang yeme e rose o bena ate akwilǝ waa rosa a were aka o kari ya deya, wayo cikǝ ko enda awata kabare okǝri wa lyǝ kawa eze bekǝri akwilǝ me ne.
Ying ma cikǝna ko enda koonang a were, o bena Kena ka oromo kaya deya a were aka ato rosa ne ko ba baate.”
Ozara edang kaa o dera edang
Na Biturusu pirkǝ na, “Ateokora angmǝ gerpo na a ba beka aza aro na, ka komana mei?”

Na Ateokora kabare wai na, “Mana ozara name ondooka a kabare ka wai a wa kang ya ko rosa? Waya ome ateokora wai yo beka wai na wa ende akwilǝ wai, a wa kang nya o dangare azara me epaolya a were aka a kedeya. Ebelo ozara name Ateokora wa ale a wa baya wai ka akwilǝ ka azara, kawa nyaza ne epaolya a were e ka wa gwara, na wa ya nyimi.
Wayo rera ozara name a Ateokora wai wa deya a wa mana wai a eza nyimi.
Eyang bele oying epeng me, wayo ote ozara name kawa itǝ ondo soola magogoro ma wai apat.

A ozara name wa beka a lenyong le wai na, ‘Ateokora ong wata dusung deya ne,’ azaa nyimia wa bora o olaza odanggare azara me andaleme ka andaye, kanza a wa taru a lyelyeza ko sosoza ka nyimia madoola wilǝ a wai.

Ateokora ozara name wayo deya a lengme leeka ozara me wata madoola ma nyimi ne, a were e ka wata rosa ne kanza. Ateokora me wayo ola wai a jǝng a wa turki wai a nyimi andaaka ne nyano kabare ka Ashili.
“Ozara ome a wa rose epa eka ateokora wai wa ya yeme a wa eze, awata babarono o deya ateokora ne na wa ta kang eza epaame a beka a wai ne, a yo ola ozara name a jǝng.

Ozara o me wata rose epa eka ateokora wai waya yeme a wa eze ne, na wa eze epa eka e bare a ole wai, a yo ola wai a baate. Pate ondooka a nya wai epa ecake, a yo gera epa ecake a wai. Ondooka a eke wai aza epa egong, a yo gera epa egong ba wai.
Angmǝ a Yeso a yo deyaka o arzanang tokpwe
“Ma deya kang diki ola ba nyimi lerambo le Ashili. O yeme ongnga aiya a samba oromboke me.
Eyang ko batisma o zitǝ, omea a yo ezang, lenyong leng leto tete ne sena a ezeng wai.
Eya gonta na ma deya lerambo le Ashili ka komana cikǝ a cammo na? Ko ba baate, eyang belo ying, ma deya adorana e arasannang a tokpwe to ying.
Epa eka e bora o ngmeengme, a nyimi akwilǝ yende aromo esu neyo arnang ka leere, aromo taaro neyo nyalang ka aromo leere, aromo leere neyo nyalang ka aromo taaro.
Ate yo nyana kena ka wai, a kena kanza kayo nyana ate a kai. Iini yo nyana kagala ka wai, a kagala kanza ka yo nyana iini kai. Ondawa wayo nyana ogiri wai, ogiri kanza wayo nyana ondawa wai.”
Yeso ka beka aromo nane cikǝ ko rosa a were
Yeso ka beka aromo a cake me na, “E laka mawere a ma era a kulu araaka ongme taaru ne e bekaana, ‘Ulyǝ yo ngmeza,’ a wa dato ngmeza.
Kanza e kono bere o sara o guri wa era, e bekaana, ‘A yo kona a huuwu,’ a wa dato ya nyimi.
Ying ana o renda aromo. E ama orosa epa ka eya ale deze ka zaa shili. Eya ka eta ama obeka eyapa azaa were na ne?
“Eyaka eta e laka osawa o ying aza epa erere ne?
Ondo wa raro aro cora angmǝ cǝ ko laka a ebabara e tata orona, ba nyana e babare, a wa yo ale ka bo ara ondo cora angmǝ. Ondo o cora ngmǝ kanza wayo taro a nyimi aro teesa aromo.
Eyang belo o, ba era o ta surǝ arame ne seeka ba are apat epa eka a core na o are, bemate be yende ato kenǝ ne.”
